steps.en: Officer opens the Court Upload Document menu
steps.id: Officer membuka menu Court Upload Document
steps.why_en: The staff portal has no court upload page or menu entry, only a label text.
steps.why_id: Portal staff tidak punya halaman atau menu upload court, hanya teks label.

steps.en: Officer picks the court case type
steps.why_en: There is no list of court case types to choose from for document upload.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada daftar jenis court case yang bisa dipilih untuk upload dokumen.

steps.en: System prompts a notice or summons number search
steps.id: Sistem meminta pencarian dengan nomor notice atau summons
steps.why_en: The search form exists but is not shown after a case type choice, because that choice does not exist.
steps.why_id: Form pencarian ada tetapi tidak muncul setelah pilih jenis, karena pilihan itu tidak ada.
